stock.description: Dowway Holdings Limited, an investment holding entity, functions as a holistic exhibition and event management specialist within the People's Republic of China. The company provides a full spectrum of services, including the design, strategic planning, coordination, and overall management of various exhibitions and events. This involves engaging with suppliers and personnel for the fabrication of necessary elements like backdrops, stages, and display booths, alongside the installation of audio, visual, and lighting infrastructure. Furthermore, they offer diligent on-site supervision for their projects. While Dowway Holdings primarily delivers these integrated services to both domestic and international automobile brands – helping them showcase, promote, and sell their vehicles – the company also undertakes exhibition and event management assignments for clients in other industries. Established in 2002, Dowway Holdings Limited is headquartered in Beijing, China, and operates as a subsidiary of A&B Development Holding Limited.
